info.title: DiploMap API
info.description: Read-only API of the Globe and Network views. Contract only: the data routes answer 501.

get.summary: List the leaders and their offices
get.description: Leaders of dim_leader, one item per leader_id, with their offices (SCD Type 2 versions).
Visits of fact_visit (Globe view), ordered by start date, optionally for one leader.

parameters.name: leader_id

schema.description: Only the visits of this leader (Wikidata QID).
schema.title: Leader Id

parameters.description: Only the visits of this leader (Wikidata QID).

get.description: One visit with the office of its leader, its PRE and POST windows and its lineage.

get.summary: Get the PRE vs POST indicators of one visit
get.description: One row of v_kpi_visit. Null means and deltas when a window has no event; counts always present.

get.summary: List the GDELT events attributed to one visit
get.description: Rows of v_visit_event for the visit, ordered by event date: events of the PRE and POST windows.
Leader VISITED and REPRESENTS Country graph (Neo4j projection), shared destinations, reciprocal visits.

Country.title: Country
Country.description: A country of dim_country, nested wherever a fact holds a country key.

Leader.title: Leader
Leader.description: A leader (one item per leader_id) with the offices of dim_leader, oldest first.

Network.title: Network
Network.description: Network view: the leader-country graph plus the two analyses of business question 5.

n_visits.title: N Visits
n_visits.description: Number of visits; null for REPRESENTS.

first_visit.title: First Visit
first_visit.description: Start date of the first visit; null for REPRESENTS.

NetworkEdge.title: NetworkEdge
NetworkEdge.description: Leader VISITED Country, or Leader REPRESENTS Country (one edge per leader and country).

iso3_code.title: Iso3 Code
iso3_code.description: Set for countries, null for leaders.

NetworkNode.title: NetworkNode
NetworkNode.description: A Leader or Country node. id is the QID of a leader or the ISO3 code of a country.

valid_to.title: Valid To
valid_to.description: Last day in office, inclusive. Null while the office is held.

Office.title: Office
Office.description: One dim_leader version (SCD Type 2): an office held during a period.

ReciprocalVisit.title: ReciprocalVisit
ReciprocalVisit.description: A country pair where a leader of each country visited the other one (country_a < country_b).

SharedDestination.title: SharedDestination
SharedDestination.description: Two leaders who visited the same countries (leader_a_id < leader_b_id).

visitor_country.description: Country represented by the leader on the start date.

duration_days.title: Duration Days
duration_days.description: Length in days, both ends included.

is_multilateral.title: Is Multilateral
is_multilateral.description: True for a multilateral event such as a summit.

matched_in_gdelt.title: Matched In Gdelt
matched_in_gdelt.description: True when GDELT also codes the visit (CAMEO 042 or 043).

position_title.title: Position Title
position_title.description: Office held by the leader on the start date.

wiki_revision_id.title: Wiki Revision Id
wiki_revision_id.description: Lineage: revision of the page that was scraped.

VisitDetail.title: VisitDetail
VisitDetail.description: A visit with the office of the leader, its PRE and POST windows and its lineage.

day_offset.title: Day Offset
day_offset.description: Days from the visit: -15..-1 before the start, +1..+15 after the end.

VisitEvent.title: VisitEvent
VisitEvent.description: A GDELT event attributed to the PRE or POST window of a visit (one row of v_visit_event).

coop_share_pre.title: Coop Share Pre
coop_share_pre.description: Share of cooperative events (quad class 1-2) in PRE.

tone_pre.title: Tone Pre
tone_pre.description: Mean media tone of the coverage in PRE.

delta_tone.title: Delta Tone
delta_tone.description: POST minus PRE. Label: "media tone of the coverage".

is_low_volume.title: Is Low Volume
is_low_volume.description: True when PRE or POST holds fewer than 10 events.

has_overlap.title: Has Overlap
has_overlap.description: True when another visit of the same country pair overlaps this one.

VisitKpis.title: VisitKpis
VisitKpis.description:
PRE vs POST indicators of one visit (one row of v_kpi_visit).

A window without events gives null means and null deltas, with a count of 0.
The counts are always returned next to the deltas.

visitor_country.description: Country represented by the leader on the start date.

duration_days.title: Duration Days
duration_days.description: Length in days, both ends included.

is_multilateral.title: Is Multilateral
is_multilateral.description: True for a multilateral event such as a summit.

matched_in_gdelt.title: Matched In Gdelt
matched_in_gdelt.description: True when GDELT also codes the visit (CAMEO 042 or 043).

VisitSummary.title: VisitSummary
VisitSummary.description: One row of fact_visit, with its leader and countries resolved.

VisitWindow.title: VisitWindow
VisitWindow.description: Window of an attributed event: 15 days before the start date or after the end date.
